SCALED AMOUNTS APPEAR IN BLUE

Procedure
01

Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 1 tsp fine salt.

02

Warm 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide pan. Add 3 cloves garlic and cook until fragrant.

03

Stir in 800 g crushed tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.

04

Cook 400 g dried pasta until just tender, then toss through the sauce.
